tio procurata; & ad summum perducta Sy-
nodus erit Oecumenica?. Qui conuenit?
Lupus in Pastorem iniurius, in gregem in-
trusus, aliena indigne occupans, a viro
multorum criminum, & depositocconsecra-
tus, potestate, ac vi secularium, & tyran-
nide dominantium promotus Synodum Oe-

i non dicent, quod nec Græci etiam ipsi Ec-
clesiæ Romanæ infensi audent dicere. Quis
præter ipsum Photium, & Photij mancipia
promotionem Photij approbauit, idque in
Photiana hac de qua agimus Synodo? Quis
Ignatium vnquam inter Græcos vti crimi-
num reum condemnatum fuisse, nisi exe-
crandissimus quispiam pronunciauit? Hæc
Synodus iustum condemnauit, & eum ipsum
quem vniuersa Græcorum Ecclesia inter San-
ctos relatum colit, & veneratur; & mult-
orum criminum reum in eius locum substi-
tuit. Non erit ergo apud Græcos, quidquid
sit apud Hæreticos, Oecumenica, cum Græ-
ci suas Oecumenicas Synodos colant, & ob-
servent, neque ab illis in aliquo deflecte-
re profiteantur. Falsum ergo est quod de
prima dicitur, quam συνοδικὸν λεγικόν vo-

page.notes: The Greek phrase after "quam" is printed in a small italic face and is hard to read; the transcription "συνοδικὸν λεγικόν" is a best reading and is not certain. The paragraph breaks within the page could not be decided with confidence, so the page is given as one paragraph continuing from the previous page. The "B" at the foot is a signature mark, not text. Show-through and fragments at the left and right edges were left out. The printed "dicitur" is kept as printed.
